title: SDK OCR find-text route is exposed without any route-level authentication or authorization dependency
reasoning: The SDK router is created with only a prefix and tags, and the POST /api/sdk/ocr/find-text handler accepts a caller-provided image/text request and immediately resolves the image source and runs OCR. In the shown route there is no FastAPI Depends, session/user validation, capability check, or request-scoped authorization before doing backend work. Because this feature crosses network, user-input, serialization, and auth trust boundaries, an exposed unauthenticated route could let any network caller submit images for OCR and receive extracted match metadata.
recommendation: Require the same authenticated SDK/session dependency used for protected backend APIs before resolving the image source or running OCR. If this endpoint is intentionally local-only, enforce that invariant in the route/dependency layer and document it in the API contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, and the excerpt shows no route-level dependency that a test could exercise for unauthorized requests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a FastAPI route test for POST /api/sdk/ocr/find-text that asserts unauthenticated or unauthorized requests are rejected before OCR/image resolution is invoked, plus an authenticated success path.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/api/routes/sdk/router.py and the focused SDK OCR route tests
